_README: Run configuration. Every value here must appear in the paper's Method section.

sampling._temperature_note: Set explicitly, not inherited from Ollama's default, so the runs are reproducible from the paper alone. Decision taken 2026-09-22.
sampling._num_ctx_note: Set explicitly. Ollama's default depends on detected VRAM, so leaving it unset makes the run machine-dependent. The longest prompt is ~1.5k tokens, so 4096 leaves ample room for the 36-item JSON reply.
sampling._num_predict_note: Generous cap; a valid reply is ~300 tokens. Prevents a rambling model from running forever without truncating a well-formed answer.
